'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]] 
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Ukrainian southern counteroffensive]]
****[[Russia]] announces that it will [[emergency evacuation|evacuate]] civilians from [[Kherson]] to "other regions of the country" following an appeal from [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Kherson Military-Civilian Administration]] leader [[Volodymyr Saldo]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/oct/13/russia-announces-kherson-evacuation-raising-fears-city-will-become-frontline?CMP=Share_iOSApp_Other (''The Guardian'')]
***[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[State terrorism|Russian forces]] launch eight missiles at [[Mykolaiv]], hitting a five-story residential building. One of the victims was an 11-year-old boy, who was rescued with broken legs after spending hours under the rubble, but later died in a hospital due to [[heart failure]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/10/13/world/russia-ukraine-war-news/russian-missiles-strike-apartment-building-in-mykolaiv#russian-missiles-strike-apartment-building-in-mykolaiv (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/russia-ukraine-war-mykolaiv-strike-boy-pulled-rubble-putin-revenge-rcna52154 (''NBC News'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[October 2022 northern Aleppo clashes]]
***The [[jihadism|jihadist]] group [[Tahrir al-Sham]] captures the city of [[Afrin, Syria|Afrin]] in [[Aleppo Governorate]], [[Syria]], following days of clashes with the [[Turkey|Turkish]]-backed [[Syrian National Army]], according to the [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/jihadist-group-takes-over-strategic-town-in-northwest-syria/6788541.html (Voice of America)]
***Tahrir al-Sham forces capture the town of [[Jindires]] amid ongoing clashes in the region. [https://english.almayadeen.net/news/politics/hts-storms-jindires-calls-for-reinforcements-in-aleppo-count (Al Mayadeen)]
**[[2022 Al-Sabboura bus bombing]]
***Eighteen [[Syrian Army|soldiers]] are killed and 20 others are injured when a bomb explodes on a military bus near [[Damascus]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/several-soldiers-dead-wounded-explosion-targeting-military-bus-syria-state-media-2022-10-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**Eleven people are killed and 53 more injured as a bus hit a [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bomb]] on a road between [[Bandiagara]] and [[Goundaka]], in the [[Mopti Region]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/14/mali-bus-blast-kills-at-least-11-people-hospital-source (AFP via Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on tourism]]
***[[Taiwan]] lifts all remaining restrictions on entering the country, which were imposed due to the [[pandemic]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/oct/13/taiwan-opens-borders-to-tourists-as-restrictions-eased-after-25-years (Associated Press via ''The Guardian'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–Iran relations]]
**[[Canada]] imposes sanctions on 17 [[Iran]]ian entities over [[human rights]] abuses, including former [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Foreign Relations Minister]] [[Mohammad Javad Zarif]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2180566/middle-east (Reuters via Arab News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Raleigh shootings]]
**Five people are killed and two others injured in a [[spree shooting]] at several locations in a suburban neighborhood of [[Raleigh]], [[North Carolina]], United States. The suspect, a 15-year-old boy, is later taken into custody and is in critical condition from injuries sustained during the shooting. [https://abc11.com/raleigh-nc-active-shooting-neuse-river-greenway/12325212/ (WTVD-TV)]
*[[Stoneman Douglas High School shooting]]
**[[Nikolas Cruz]], the preperator of the 2018 [[Stoneman Douglas High School shooting]] is spared the death penalty for life in prison. He is scheduled to be sentenced on November 1. [https://www.nbcnews.com/think/opinion/parkland-shooting-nikolas-cruz-spared-death-penalty-victims-families-m-rcna51719 (NBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[2022 Swedish general election]], [[Tidö Agreement]]
**Swedish [[right-wing]] parties sign an agreement to form a government led by [[Ulf Kristersson]]. The government will include the [[Moderate Party]], the [[Christian Democrats (Sweden)|Christian Democrats]], the [[Liberals (Sweden)|Liberals]], and will be supported by the [[Sweden Democrats]]. [https://www.dn.se/sverige/tidoavtalet-liberalerna-i-regeringen-sd-utanfor/ (Dagens Nyheter)]
*[[2022 Vanuatuan general election]]
**[[Vanuatu]]ans head to the polls in a [[snap election]] to vote for the members of [[parliament of Vanuatu|parliament]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/476575/polls-open-in-vanuatu-for-snap-election (RNZ)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
**Rare anti-government [[Beijing Sitong Bridge protest|protests]] occur in [[Beijing]] ahead of the [[20th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party|20th National Congress]] of the ruling [[Chinese Communist Party]], protesting the government [[Chinese government response to COVID-19#Zero-COVID policy|"Zero-COVID" policy]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-63238617 (BBC News)]
*Rival [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] factions sign an agreement in [[Algiers]], [[Algeria]], aimed at resolving over 15 years of discord. The agreement is signed by senior [[Fatah]] leader [[Azzam al-Ahmad]], [[Hamas]] political chief [[Ismael Haniyeh]], [[Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine]] general secretary Talal Naji, and leaders and representatives of 14 other factions, and calls for legislative and presidential elections to be held in [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] within one year.  [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/13/palestinian-factions-sign-reconciliation-agreement-in-algeria (Al Jazeera)]
